name: Directional Derivative Diffuse Lighting
definition: An approximation for diffuse lighting in volumetric raymarching that estimates light scattering by comparing density at the current point and an offset point in the light direction, avoiding the need for normal calculation.
summary: Directional Derivative Diffuse Lighting approximates volumetric diffuse lighting by comparing density at two points along the light direction, requiring only two samples instead of multiple gradient estimates for normals.
